purpose: Mask-stage preservation of fine Gleason labels and encoded gland topology; rendering of Gleason architecture is a downstream responsibility.

constraints.mask_statement: A burden edit may alter only the declared source-to-target pixels; all Gleason 3, 4, and 5 fine IDs outside that transition remain pixel-identical.
generation_handoff: Render only the retained fine pattern; ID preservation does not guarantee pattern-appropriate glands.
known_limitations: A coarse tumor-only profile cannot provide Gleason-level enforcement.

constraints.mask_statement: If gland instances or lumen maps exist, reject gland split/merge, lumen filling, and partial benign-gland cuts; if only H&E reveals them, treat protection as conditional and abstain when a legal band cannot be established.
generation_handoff: Generate well-formed, fused/cribriform, or non-gland-forming architecture according to the retained Gleason pattern and re-audit after rendering.
known_limitations: PANDA semantic masks do not explicitly encode gland instances or lumina.

constraints.mask_statement: Use one existing directed component interface, keep all pixels inside its band, and reject short/deep changes or changes detached from that interface.
generation_handoff: Use a same-pattern H&E reference for the newly changed band.
known_limitations: The mask gate cannot determine whether adjacent H&E truly matches the fine pattern.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not create tumor islands, split source tissue, merge separate target components, or add/fill holes.
known_limitations: True grade-transition or topology-changing tasks require separate primitives.
